description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Batuwanhena, Elpitiya D/S Division, Galle District (24-14-4-00036)
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, declaring determinations for specific land parcels (Parcel Nos. 1:166, 1:170, etc.) in Batuwanhena village. It contains a detailed schedule of land ownership particulars, extents, and title classifications. The content is exclusively focused on land matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative actions.
